response: Well-differentiated hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is not considered clinically early cancer. Research has shown that there is no significant difference in disease-free survival between patients with well-differentiated (w-d) and less-differentiated (l-d) HCCs. This suggests that well-differentiated HCCs do not necessarily have a better prognosis or behave like early-stage cancer. Therefore, the prognosis of well-differentiated small hepatocellular carcinoma is not indicative of an early cancer stage.
